lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines spanning the lateral torso. Spacing is tighter at the anterior (shoulder) region and widens significantly towards the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 3 and line 7 from the anterior boundary exhibit mid-torso termination; several posterior lines fade into lower torso pixels without reaching the ventral line.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Three distinct high-contrast white spots observed on the lower haunch, clustered near the posterior edge of the thigh.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two white spots on the mid-hind limb align horizontally to form a short geometric segment.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white band at the base of the neck; two distinct white spots on the lower cheek/jaw area; white chevron marking on the bridge of the muzzle.
